seo.title: Mercedes-Benz: MBUX voice assistant augmented with ChatGPT - more than 3 million vehicles (2024)
seo.meta_description: Mercedes-Benz pushed ChatGPT via Azure OpenAI to more than 3 million MBUX vehicles in December 2024, after a US beta of 900,000 vehicles in 2023.
seo.resume_citable: In December 2024, Mercedes-Benz made ChatGPT (Azure OpenAI + Bing) available as a free update on more than three million MBUX vehicles, after a US beta covering more than 900,000 vehicles in June 2023.

faq.q: What technology powers Mercedes-Benz's genAI voice assistant?
faq.a: ChatGPT via Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service, coupled with a Microsoft Bing search for up-to-date answers.

faq.q: On how many vehicles is the feature deployed?
faq.a: More than three million MBUX-equipped vehicles worldwide since December 2024, after a US beta of more than 900,000 vehicles in 2023.

objectif_business: Enrich the in-car voice assistant with natural-language answers on open topics, beyond vehicle commands, to strengthen brand attachment over the ownership period and differentiate the onboard experience.
description: On vehicles equipped with the MBUX infotainment system, the user activates the assistant by saying Hey Mercedes or via the steering-wheel button. Beyond the classic commands (navigation, phone, climate control), the assistant triggers a Bing search and has ChatGPT, via Azure OpenAI, write a natural-language answer. The driver can ask general-knowledge questions, about a destination, the weather, a recipe, and continue the conversation on the topic. Launched as a beta program in the US on June 16, 2023 for more than 900,000 vehicles, then pushed into series production to more than three million vehicles worldwide via a remote update in December 2024, in German, British English and American English.

resultats.metrique: Vehicles eligible for the ChatGPT update (series production, December 2024)
Vehicles in the US beta program (June 2023)

niveau_preuve.justification: Public deployment figure (more than three million vehicles) from Mercedes-Benz's official press release and picked up by several concordant press outlets; no financial metric isolating the impact, hence level C rather than A.

stack_technique.detail: Conversational model that writes natural-language answers to the driver's open questions.
Cloud hosting of the ChatGPT model used by Mercedes-Benz for the assistant's generative layer.
Web search triggered by the assistant to retrieve up-to-date information before writing the answer.
Onboard infotainment system that captures the voice, distinguishes vehicle command from open question, and delivers the answer.
Storage and anonymization of voice command data before analysis.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time, one request at a time during the trip.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Mercedes-Benz's connected services and voice team, with Microsoft Azure OpenAI on the back end.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The voice request and its context. Without cellular connectivity or cloud access, the search and genAI answer part falls away and the assistant falls back on local commands.

etapes.detail: The driver says Hey Mercedes or presses the steering-wheel button.
The MBUX assistant distinguishes a vehicle command from an open question; open questions go to the genAI layer.
A Bing search retrieves up-to-date information, ChatGPT via Azure OpenAI writes a natural-language answer.
The answer is read to the driver, who can continue the conversation on the same topic.
The voice command data is stored in the Mercedes-Benz Intelligent Cloud, anonymized then analyzed.

prerequis_data: up-to-date reference content (web search or knowledge base)
prerequis_orga: legal and privacy agreement on sending requests to the cloud
stack_possible: Azure OpenAI or equivalent cloud LLM
replication.equipe: 1 voice PM + 2-4 embedded/connected services devs + 1 cloud/LLM engineer, with privacy legal support.

playbook.action: Isolate the open questions the current voice assistant cannot handle and frame the legal side of consent to sending requests to the cloud.
playbook.livrable: Prioritized list of use cases and validated privacy file.

playbook.action: Prototype the intent routing (vehicle command vs open question) and plug a cloud LLM with web search on a test bench.
playbook.livrable: Working prototype outside the vehicle with measured latency.

playbook.action: Harden the system: filtering of sensitive topics, behavior on connectivity loss, embedded ASR/TTS integration.
playbook.livrable: Hardened version tested in real driving conditions.

playbook.action: Open a beta program on a subset of the fleet via remote update and measure voice engagement.
playbook.livrable: Beta report: usage, requested topics, incidents.

playbook.action: Deploy into series production via OTA update and track usage in production.
playbook.livrable: Feature in production on the target fleet with a usage dashboard.

replication.premiere_etape: Isolate the open questions the current voice assistant cannot handle and route them to an LLM with search.

statut_vivant.note: Feature pushed into series production via remote update in December 2024, active on the MBUX fleet; the brand also announced the next-generation MBUX Virtual Assistant genAI (MB.OS) for the following platforms.

transposable_ue.note: Already deployed in Germany and the UK as of December 2024. The voice command data transits through the Mercedes-Benz Intelligent Cloud then is anonymized; the GDPR watchpoint concerns consent to sending the request to Azure OpenAI and Bing.
